title: Modules courbes elliptiques en caractéristiques ≠2 : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: No mathematical errors. All ten interpretations check: edge stabilizer generated by a transposition; face-diagonal stabilizer generated by a double transposition (rotation by pi about a face axis, lying in V); G/V acts simply transitively on the 6 ordered pairs of distinct elements of J.

Minor ambiguity: the phrase about the 12 face diagonals 'corresponding to elements of order 2 (translations in V)' should be read as 'stabilizers are generated by elements of V'. There are only 3 such elements, each fixing 4 face diagonals.

ideas.what: Triviality of the Baer sum of the three F_2-torsors D_i = I/Q_i, via reduction of structure group of I ⊂ prod D_i to V_J(F_2)
ideas.modern_name: Reduction of structure group of torsors / contracted product of Z/2-torsors; Klein four-group acting simply transitively on 4 points

ideas.what: Interpretation of all 10 conjugacy classes of proper subgroups of S_4 ≅ Aut^+(cube) as geometric elements of the cube (vertices, edges, faces, antipodal pairs, face diagonals, tetrahedra/orientations, frames, ordered pairs of axes)
ideas.modern_name: Subgroup lattice / table of marks of the octahedral group; transitive G-sets of S_4

ideas.what: Using cube combinatorics as a model for level-4 structures (Z/4-modules of rank 2), with PSL_2(Z/4) ≅ S_4
ideas.modern_name: Level-4 modular curves X(4) and octahedral symmetry; dessins of congruence subgroups
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses regular polyhedra / dessins in general terms

deep.surprise_reason: A careful but classical verification: the 10 transitive S_4-sets realised geometrically on the cube, plus a small torsor identity. It is interesting only as context for Grothendieck's torsor-theoretic treatment of level-4 structures. Nothing new to specialists.
transcription_corrections: The line 'de structure associés au cube (tels sommets,' is duplicated in the machine transcription; it appears only once on the page.
'antipodismes – i.e. que le cube garantit [?]' is uncertain; the sense is antipodal pairs (of vertices, edges, faces).
'correspondant aux 𝔍. diagonales des faces' should read roughly 'correspondant aux 12 diagonales des faces (les 12 correspondant aux él. d'ordre 2 ...)'.
'division qui se fait des paires d'éléments distincts' likely refers to the 6-element quotient G/V interpreted as ordered pairs of distinct elements of J; 'M_J' there is doubtful (perhaps just 'J').

Margin, rough reading: 'partition relative de deux sommets à dist. 1 (ou 2) : sommets à dist. 1, ou arêtes : dist. 2' – a description of the 2-element set (the two inscribed tetrahedra) by vertex parity.
